title: Senior IT Administrator
description:
#### **Location**

India – Pune

#### **Full/Part Time**

Full time

#### **Experience Level**

7+ years

##### **About Finzly**

Headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and founded in 2012 by visionary minds shaping the future of banking and payments in the US, **Finzly makes bank transformation radically simple.** Our core-independent platform is trusted by some of the market’s leading financial institutions to transform operations and launch new products and services at speed.

We’ve been recognized with 20+ industry awards—including three years in a row as one of the Best and Brightest Places to Work—as well as accolades for Best Parallel Core Technology, Best Corporate Payments Solution, Best Payments-as-a-Service Provider, and Best Trading System. Quite simply, Finzly is known for being the best in everything we do, giving you the perfect opportunity to grow your career with impact.

### **About the Role:**

We are seeking a Senior IT Systems Administrator to own day-to-day endpoint, identity, network, and cloud infrastructure operations during a high-impact contract engagement. The role spans the full device lifecycle — Autopilot provisioning, Intune policy management, Defender for Endpoint hardening, Zscaler secure access, Fortinet network infrastructure, patching, vulnerability remediation, and asset management — all within a regulated financial services environment. You will partner with Information Security, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to maintain zero-trust posture, endpoint compliance, and audit readiness.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the full endpoint lifecycle via Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot — zero-touch provisioning, compliance policies, configuration profiles, app deployment, BitLocker enforcement, USB blocking and selective wipe.
* Own patching and vulnerability management program — Intune ring-based deployment, third-party patching (Autopilot) and remediation & SLA compliance.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory — Conditional Access Policy, Attack Surface Reduction, PIM, MFA and SSO enforcement.
* Deploy and operate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (AV/AM, EDR, ASR, AIR) and Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) to maintain endpoint security and zero-trust network access.
* Manage and maintain Fortinet network infrastructure — FortiGate firewalls (policy rules, VPN tunnels, NAT, IPS/threat protection), FortiSwitch (VLAN configuration, port security, link aggregation), and FortiAP wireless access points (SSID management, RF optimization, guest networks).
* Coordinate ISP circuit management — liaison with service providers on circuit provisioning, outage escalation, bandwidth upgrades, and SLA tracking for primary and redundant WAN links.
* Administer Microsoft 365 services and the SharePoint Admin Center — Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, site permissions and retention policies.
* Manage IT asset inventory across the full lifecycle — procurement, assignment, warranty tracking, and secure disposal/decommissioning.
* Develop PowerShell automation for remediation, compliance reporting, configuration-drift detection, and bulk operations.
* Maintain runbooks, SOPs, network diagrams, and knowledge-base articles; provide audit evidence for SOC 1/2, PCI DSS, FFIEC, and NYDFS examinations.
* Provide support for network, VPN, Wi-Fi, and Zscaler connectivity issues; participate in incident response as needed. Maintain IP address management.

### **Requirements:**

* 8–10+ years of progressive IT systems administration or endpoint engineering experience, preferably in financial services or equivalent.
* Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Autopilot — enrollment, compliance/ configuration profiles, Win32 app packaging, and all deployment modes.
* Strong Entra ID / Active Directory skills — Conditional Access, PIM, etc.
* Proven Defender for Endpoint and Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) administration — EDR investigation, ASR tuning, policy configuration, and client troubleshooting.
* Hands-on Fortinet experience — firewall administration (policies, VPN, NAT, IPS), FortiSwitch management, and FortiAP wireless deployment and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ISP circuit coordination (provisioning, outage management, SLA tracking) and IP address management (DHCP scoping, DNS, subnet planning).
* Hands-on patching and vulnerability management experience — scan triage, risk-based prioritization, and compliance reporting.
* Proficient in PowerShell scripting; BitLocker enforcement, recovery-key escrow, and TPM management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

### **Education Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field — required.

### **Certifications:**

**Mandatory** **(at least 2)**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* CompTIA Security+
* CompTIA CySA+ (Cybersecurity Analyst)
* Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP)

**Recommended /** **P****referrred**

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* CompTIA Network+
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
* Fortinet NSE 4 — Network Security Professional (FortiGate)
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Practitioner (ZCCP) or Zscaler Certified Engineer (ZCE)

### **Apply:**

Interested candidates can send their resume to Finzly at careers@finzly.com

**Interested? Apply now.**
--------------------------

Please submit your resume and coverletter to us at careers@finzly.com.

title: Network Engineering Security
description:
Date live: 10/09/2026

Business Area: GTIS

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000105754

  

Join Barclays as a Network Engineering Security role, where to build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  
  

**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**

* Network engineering activities (which covers design , testing and certification, upgrades and Vulnerability management activities in lab and support in Prod )
* The Engineer should be subject Matter Expert primarily in Fortigate firewalls and IDS and secondarily with Zscaler , Cisco ASA ,
* Basic know of tools integration like SNMP based ( DX NetOps) , Syslog ( Elastic Search /Observe ) , TACACS/Radius / RSA Server
  

  

**Some other highly valued skills may include below:**

  
  

* Ansible Automation Understanding is important to provide the logic to other engineers for compliance check and remediation
* Detailed basic network packet Flow understanding is important
* Support network Operation team for any issue with Network Product – like Vulnerability , Bugs , upgrade issues
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based in Pune office.

  
  

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Remote Support Engineer
description:
Remote Support Engineer – Desktop Support

**Location:** Hadapsar, Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 2+ Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹3.5 LPA  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Shift:** Rotational Shifts – 24/6 Support

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Remote Support Engineer with 2+ years of experience in Desktop Support, Windows OS troubleshooting, hardware support, and IT service management. The candidate should have strong technical knowledge of Windows 11, Microsoft Outlook, Active Directory, network connectivity, and remote troubleshooting tools.

Key Responsibilities

* **Windows OS Troubleshooting:** Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows 11 operating system issues by analysing system event logs, system behaviour, updates, and upgrades rather than relying only on formatting. Knowledge of Windows Registry and common registry settings is required.
* **Hardware Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve hardware issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, and scanners. Coordinate with third-party vendors and manage hardware-related service calls.
* **Microsoft Outlook Support:** Troubleshoot Microsoft Outlook 2007, 2013, and 2016, including common mail-related issues. Knowledge of Microsoft Office licensing, features, and activation is an advantage.
* **Ticket Management:** Categorise tickets, maintain accurate work logs, and monitor ticket status, including Assigned, Work in Progress, and Pending. Familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or Jira is preferred.
* **OS, BIOS and Firmware Support:** Troubleshoot Windows OS issues, perform OS upgrades, and support BIOS and firmware-related activities.
* **Network Connectivity:** Diagnose and resolve LAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity issues.
* **Directory and Network Services:** Good understanding of Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, and Remote Desktop or other remote support tools.
* **System Compliance:** Monitor and troubleshoot system compliance parameters, including SCCM, antivirus, Windows versions, and related endpoint management requirements.
* **System Performance:** Troubleshoot Group Policy issues, slow system performance, mailbox storage limits, low disk space, and other system-level problems.

Good to Have

* Knowledge of ITIL processes and SLA-driven service delivery.
* Experience with IT ticketing tools and incident management.
* Familiarity with remote desktop and endpoint management tools.

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

* Candidates must have **2+ years of relevant IT/Desktop Support experience**.
* Distance, part-time, and online education qualifications are not acceptable.
* Overlapping education and employment periods are not acceptable.
* Education-to-employment gaps or employment gaps exceeding one year may not be acceptable.
* Salary received in cash is not acceptable; salary must be paid through a verifiable banking channel.
* Former TCS employees are not eligible for re-hiring for this requirement.
* Immediate joiners are preferred.

Interested Candidates

Candidates with relevant Desktop Support, Remote Support, or IT Infrastructure Support experience are encouraged to apply with their updated resume.

Pay: ₹24,000.00 - ₹26,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **About ZM Technologies**

ZM Technologies is a system integrator and Managed IT Services provider offering IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, backup, hardware and technical support solutions to businesses across different industries.

We are looking for an L2 Technical Support Engineer who can independently troubleshoot IT infrastructure issues, support client environments and work closely with L1, L3 and OEM teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The L2 Technical Support Engineer will be responsible for providing advanced technical support for client IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, endpoints, backups, Microsoft 365, Active Directory and virtualization environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills, good communication, hands-on infrastructure knowledge and the ability to work in a managed services/system integrator environment.

### **Backup & Recovery Support**

* Monitor and verify daily backup jobs using Veeam, Commvault/Metallic and Druva.
* Troubleshoot backup failures and perform basic corrective actions.
* Perform file, folder, mailbox and system-level restores as per client requirements.
* Support Microsoft 365 and endpoint backup and recovery activities.
* Monitor backup health, capacity and retention status and escalate critical issues to L3/OEM teams.
* Maintain backup reports and update incident/ticket details.

### **Server & Infrastructure Support**

* Provide L2 technical support for Windows Server, Active Directory and virtualization environments.
* Troubleshoot issues related to Windows services, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and user authentication.
* Support VMware/Hyper-V environments and perform basic VM-related troubleshooting.
* Assist in server, storage and network infrastructure deployment and configuration.
* Perform rack-and-stack, cabling, hardware installation and replacement at client locations.
* Coordinate with L3 engineers and OEMs for complex server, storage and infrastructure issues.

We are seeking a highly skilled **Security Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Engineer** with expertise in **Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), OWASP Security Testing, Security Compliance, Vulnerability Management, AI Security Testing, and Cloud Security Assessments** . The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating security vulnerabilities across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, APIs, infrastructure, and AI/GenAI solutions.

The role requires hands-on experience in conducting comprehensive security assessments, penetration testing, cloud security reviews, and compliance validation activities. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, cloud, AI/ML, and security teams to ensure secure software delivery and maintain a strong organizational security posture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for web applications, APIs, mobile applications, cloud environments, and enterprise systems.
* Identify security weaknesses and validate exploitability through controlled testing methodologies.
* Conduct black-box, gray-box, and white-box security assessments.
* Execute internal and external network penetration testing exercises.
* Document findings and provide detailed remediation recommendations.

**Application Security Testing**

* Conduct secure code reviews and application security assessments.
* Perform Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST).
* Validate application security controls and authentication mechanisms.
* Assess session management, authorization, encryption, and input validation controls.
* Ensure adherence to secure coding practices and industry standards.

**OWASP Security Validation**

* Evaluate applications against OWASP Top 10 security risks.
* Identify vulnerabilities such as:
* + Broken Access Control
  + Injection Attacks
  + Security Misconfigurations
  + Cryptographic Failures
  + Authentication Weaknesses
  + Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
  + Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
  + Vulnerable Components
* Conduct security reviews during development and pre-production releases.
* Support secure SDLC initiatives and security-by-design implementations.

**Cloud Security Assessment**

* Perform security assessments of cloud-native applications and infrastructure.
* Evaluate cloud security configurations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Review IAM policies, network security controls, storage configurations, and encryption standards.
* Conduct cloud security posture assessments and identify misconfigurations.
* Assess container, Kubernetes, and microservices security implementations.

**AI & GenAI Security Testing**

* Conduct security testing of AI/ML and Generative AI applications.
* Assess AI systems for risks related to:
* + Prompt Injection
  + Data Poisoning
  + Model Manipulation
  + Data Leakage
  + Adversarial Attacks
  + Unauthorized Access
* Validate security controls for RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM integrations.
* Evaluate AI governance and responsible AI security requirements.
* Develop AI-specific threat models and test scenarios.

**Vulnerability Management**

* Manage enterprise vulnerability assessment programs.
* Analyze scan results and prioritize remediation activities based on risk.
* Track vulnerabilities through closure using governance processes.
* Establish vulnerability reporting dashboards and KPIs.
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams for remediation planning.

**Security Compliance & Governance**

* Support compliance assessments and audits.
* Ensure security controls align with organizational security standards.
* Assist with regulatory and compliance reviews.
* Prepare evidence and documentation required for audits.
* Participate in security governance reviews and risk assessments.

**Security Reporting & Risk Analysis**

* Generate VAPT reports with executive summaries and technical findings.
* Present security risks and remediation strategies to stakeholders.
* Conduct threat assessments and risk analysis activities.
* Develop security metrics and reporting mechanisms.
* Support management with compliance and security posture updates.

* CCNA/
* MCSA / Microsoft-related certification

title: Bid and Project Engineer Marine
description:
**Join Alfa Laval PES Team as Bid and Project Engineer-** **Marine, Offshore & Naval Skid Systems**

**About the Company:**

In Alfa Laval, we are every single day contributing to a more sustainable future for our planet through engineering innovation. Our global team designs and implements the refining, recycling and purifying process that allows our customers to be better themselves. You will find our work in leading applications for water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, pharmaceutical development and much more. The people of Alfa Laval enjoy the freedom to pursue ideas and the resources to see those ideas to become reality, in an environment that welcomes drive, courage and diversity. The result is a company where we can all be very proud of what we do.

Our core competencies are in the areas of heat transfer separation, and fluid handling. We are dedicated to optimizing the performance of our customers' processes. Our world-class technologies, our systems, equipment, and services must create solutions that help our customers stay ahead.

**Job Purpose**

We are seeking a hands-on Bid & Project Engineer to engineer and execute skid-mounted systems and packages for marine, offshore, naval and engineered equipment applications.

The role covers the complete project lifecycle: RFQ, bid engineering, costing, detailed engineering, procurement support, manufacturing, FAT, documentation and delivery.

**Bid & Project Engineer – Marine, Offshore & Naval Skid Systems**

**Location:** Pune

**Experience:** 8–10 years

**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Chemical or Marine Engineering

**Travel:** Approximately 10% annually

**Key Responsibilities**

* Study customer RFQs, specifications, tenders and technical requirements.
* Develop technical solutions, system configurations, preliminary P&IDs and equipment selections.
* Prepare technical proposals, compliance statements, deviations, datasheets, BOMs and utility requirements.
* Support project costing and identify technical risks, scope gaps and exclusions.
* Prepare and review engineering documents, including:
  + P&IDs, equipment and valve lists
  + Datasheets and specifications
  + BOM/MTO and technical purchase requisitions
  + Vendor technical evaluations
  + Control, instrumentation and interface requirements
  + FAT procedures and O&M documentation
* Provide technical inputs and sketches to designers and check drawings for correctness, accessibility, maintainability and manufacturability.
* Engineer packages involving pumps, filters, vessels, heat exchangers, valves, piping, instruments, motors, panels and structural skids.
* Support procurement, fabrication, assembly and shop-floor problem solving.
* Resolve technical issues, non-conformities and manufacturing deviations.
* Lead or support inspections, functional testing and FAT with customers, shipyards, inspectors and classification societies.
* Manage customer comments, technical changes, as-built documentation and project interfaces.
* Support commissioning, troubleshooting and site activities when required.
* Independently make practical engineering decisions and constructively challenge customers, Sales, suppliers and Factory when necessary.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 8–10 years of experience in engineered skids, package systems or similar equipment.
* Experience in both bid engineering and project execution.
* Strong capability in P&ID development and interpretation.
* Hands-on experience preparing technical engineering documents.
* Knowledge of mechanical equipment, piping, valves, instrumentation and controls.
* Experience with equipment selection and supplier technical evaluations.
* Experience providing design inputs and checking GA, layout, piping and fabrication drawings.
* Practical shop-floor, manufacturing and FAT experience.
* Ability to work independently and resolve technical problems effectively.
* Strong customer communication and technical decision-making skills.
* Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.

**Preferred Experience**

* Marine, offshore, naval, FPSO/FSO or shipyard projects.
* Indian Navy or naval vessel applications.
* Classification societies such as DNV, ABS, Lloyd’s Register, Bureau Veritas or IRS.
* Exposure to marine corrosion, vibration, shock, hazardous areas, weight/space constraints and applicable ASME, API, IEC, ISO and marine standards.

This role is suited to an engineer who takes technical ownership from customer specification through final delivery—not just coordination and follow-up.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Exposure to global suppliers and international projects.

Build a strong professional network across different countries and cultures.

Play a key role in delivering successful customer projects.

Continuous learning and career development opportunities.

**Reporting to:** Group Leader Quotation and Engineering • HSS Project Execution Team

title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
description:
Job Description

**Your role**
-------------

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency.

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins.

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects.

**Technical and Product Environment**
-------------------------------------

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria.
* Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements.
* Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability.
* Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.
* Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team.
* Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality.
* Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers.
* Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

* Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation.
* Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements.
* Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins.
* Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship.
* Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence.
* Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives.
* Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology.
* Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network.
* Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility.
* Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance.

**Job location**
----------------

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team.

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Siebel CRM application operations professional** to manage the day-to-day operational health and technical support of Oracle Siebel CRM and associated platforms from **SP Infocity, Pune**.

This hands-on role focuses on service stability, SLA adherence, major incident and problem resolution, proactive monitoring, technical troubleshooting, automation, operational governance and continual service improvement. You will act as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and work across Siebel CRM, Oracle BSS and connected technology teams.

You should bring **7–10 years of Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations experience**, including at least **5 years of hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**. Working knowledge of SRE practices, observability and automation is important for improving reliability, service performance and operational efficiency.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Application support and technical operations**

* Manage day-to-day support and operational health of Oracle Siebel CRM services.
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, service degradation and cross-system issues.
* Coordinate P1/P2 incident triage, technical analysis, service restoration and timely stakeholder communication.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting using Siebel logs, workflow and component analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux utilities and monitoring data.
* Coordinate end-to-end diagnosis across FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, database, infrastructure and network teams.

### **SLA, service management and governance**

* Track adherence to agreed incident response, restoration and service request SLAs.
* Review service KPIs including availability, SLA compliance, incident trends, MTTR, MTTD, backlog and recurring failures.
* Support weekly and monthly service reviews with concise reporting covering operational performance, risks, actions and dependencies.
* Keep operational controls, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures and audit evidence current and ensure agreed processes are followed.
* Support change and release governance through risk assessments, readiness checks, validation evidence and post-change monitoring.

### **Problem management and continual improvement**

* Lead technical investigations into recurring incidents and contribute to high-quality root cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Maintain and prioritise a service-improvement backlog using incident trends, monitoring gaps and operational risks.
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, alert responses, reporting, housekeeping and repetitive support activities.
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, dashboards and early detection to reduce customer impact and operational effort.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure and validate that improvements deliver sustainable results.

### **Team and stakeholder coordination**

* Provide technical guidance, work-allocation support and knowledge sharing for application support engineers.
* Collaborate with Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners.
* Escalate risks, capacity concerns, vendor dependencies and unresolved service issues through agreed governance channels.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Technical knowledge and experience**

* You have **7–10 years' experience** in Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations.
* You have at least **5 years' hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**.
* You have strong knowledge of Siebel CRM architecture, server components, configuration, Workflows, eScript, Business Services, EAI, Integration Objects, inbound/outbound web services and Open UI troubleshooting.
* You understand Siebel administration, including component health, tasks, sessions, logs, parameters and environment checks.
* You have strong Oracle SQL/PLSQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting and performance investigation.
* You can use Unix/Linux and Shell scripting for log analysis, health checks, housekeeping and operational automation.
* You understand telecom order management, product catalogue, customer and service-request flows.
* You can troubleshoot integrations involving FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic and downstream systems.
* You have hands-on experience with one or more observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix.
* You understand cloud, containers and Kubernetes/OKE operations, including pod health, logs, events, resource usage and restart validation.
* You have awareness of CI/CD, configuration control and rollback principles in an application-operations environment.
* You have experience supporting business-critical services and resolving complex production incidents within SLA.

### **Service management and collaboration**

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request management.
* You have working knowledge of the ITIL framework and production-operations controls.
* You have experience with SLA/KPI tracking, service reporting and operational governance.
* You can contribute to effective RCA, risk management and continual service improvement.
* You can coordinate effectively with stakeholders, vendors and cross-functional teams.
* You communicate technical and operational information clearly in writing and verbally.
* Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, monitoring or continual-service-improvement initiatives is important.

### **Preferred qualifications and experience**

* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Exposure to Kubernetes/OKE, cloud operations, DevOps/SRE practices and enterprise observability tools.
* Experience with telecom order management and Oracle BSS integrations.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**

The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical **Oracle Siebel CRM and Oracle BSS services**.Exposure to complex, cross-platform telecom operations spanning FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, databases, infrastructure and networks.Opportunities to contribute to service reliability through **SRE practices, observability, automation and continual service improvement**.Experience influencing improvements measured through availability, SLA compliance, MTTR, MTTD, incident recurrence and change stability.Collaboration across Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners.

title: Software Dev Senior Engineer
description:
**SonicWall** is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit **www.sonicwall.com** or follow us on **Twitter**, **LinkedIn**, **Facebook** and **Instagram**.


CSE SRE – DBA Focus


**Job Description**



As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud\-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.
* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on\-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on\-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production\-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision\-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.


**Required:**


* 5\+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5\+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4\+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.
* Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale.
* Experience managing other database systems — PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc .
* CS Degree or equivalent experience.


**Preferred:**


* Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
* Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues.
* Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments.
* Experience resolving customer\-facing production issues under time pressure.
* Experience working with distributed, cross\-functional teams
* Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
* Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.
* Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
* Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes.
* Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent).
* Experience with incident management platforms and on\-call tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

title: SENIOR ESTIMATION & TENDERING ENGINEER
description:
**SENIOR ESTIMATION \& TENDERING ENGINEER**

**Company:** Electropath Services India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra – Head Office  
**Department:** Tendering / Estimation / Commercial / Projects  
**Experience:** 7–12 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Electrical Infrastructure \| Power \| EPC \| Substation \| Transmission \| Solar

**About Electropath Services India Pvt. Ltd.**

Electropath Services India Pvt. Ltd. is a Pune\-based electrical engineering and infrastructure company working in the areas of **power transmission, distribution, substations, electrical infrastructure, EPC and renewable energy projects**. The company has experience in engineering, erection, commissioning, testing and maintenance of electrical infrastructure projects.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Estimation \& Tendering Engineer** with **7–12 years of relevant experience** in electrical estimation, tendering and costing, preferably from the **Power / Electrical Infrastructure / EPC / Substation / Transmission / Solar** industry.

The candidate will be responsible for handling **end\-to\-end estimation and tendering activities**, including studying tender documents, preparing BOQs, quantity take\-offs, rate analysis, costing, vendor quotations, technical and commercial bid preparation, and final tender submission.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of **electrical infrastructure projects, substations, HT/LT systems, transmission and distribution networks, solar projects and EPC costing**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Tender Analysis \& Tendering**

* Study and analyse tender documents, NIT, BOQ, drawings, specifications and scope of work.
* Review technical specifications, commercial conditions and contractual requirements.
* Identify important tender requirements, exclusions, assumptions and deviations.
* Prepare and manage complete tender documentation.
* Handle both **online and offline tendering activities**.
* Monitor tender submission deadlines and ensure timely submission.
* Work on government, PSU, utility, DISCOM and private EPC tenders.
* Analyse tender corrigendum, amendments and revised BOQs.

**2\. Estimation \& Costing**

* Prepare detailed project estimates for electrical infrastructure and EPC projects.
* Prepare item\-wise **BOQ, quantity take\-off and cost sheets**.
* Carry out detailed rate analysis for:
* Electrical materials
* Equipment
* Cables
* Structures
* Labour
* Installation and erection
* Testing \& commissioning
* Civil works
* Transportation
* Subcontracting
* Tools, plant and machinery
* Prepare detailed material and labour cost estimates.
* Analyse project requirements and calculate overall project cost.
* Prepare competitive and commercially viable estimates.
* Maintain historical project cost data for future tender preparation.

**3\. Power \& Electrical Infrastructure Projects**

The candidate should have practical understanding of estimation for projects such as:

* **33/11 kV substations**
* HT/LT electrical infrastructure
* Power distribution networks
* Transmission lines
* Substation equipment
* Solar PV projects
* Electrical EPC projects
* Transformer installation
* HT/LT cables
* Cable trenching
* Earthing systems
* Switchyards
* Control rooms and associated civil works
* Street lighting / electrical infrastructure, where applicable
* Testing and commissioning activities

Experience in **MSEDCL, DISCOM, RDSS, MSKVY or similar power\-sector projects** will be an advantage.

**4\. BOQ \& Quantity Analysis**

* Prepare and review BOQs based on drawings, specifications and scope of work.
* Verify quantities and identify missing or incorrect items.
* Perform quantity take\-offs from drawings and tender documents.
* Prepare material requirement sheets.
* Compare tender BOQ with internal estimation.
* Identify major cost\-impacting items and project\-specific requirements.

**5\. Vendor \& Subcontractor Coordination**

* Obtain technical and commercial quotations from vendors, manufacturers and subcontractors.
* Prepare vendor comparison statements.
* Analyse vendor quotations against tender specifications.
* Verify technical compliance before considering commercial quotations.
* Maintain vendor rate databases.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Engineering teams for technical and commercial inputs.
* Negotiate or support negotiation of rates wherever required.
* Develop and maintain reliable vendor/subcontractor contacts.

**6\. Rate Analysis \& Market Research**

* Monitor current market prices for electrical equipment and materials.
* Maintain updated rates for major project materials.
* Compare historical rates with current market rates.
* Analyse material price fluctuations.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Maintain a database of material, labour, transportation and subcontracting rates.

**7\. Technical \& Commercial Bid Preparation**

* Prepare technical and commercial bid documents.
* Prepare price schedules and commercial summaries.
* Review technical compliance against tender specifications.
* Prepare deviation, exclusion and assumption statements.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Projects, Finance and Management teams.
* Support management in tender review and bid decision meetings.
* Prepare final estimation for management approval before submission.

**8\. Excel \& MIS**

Strong knowledge of **Advanced MS Excel** is required.

The candidate should be comfortable working with:

* VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
* INDEX \& MATCH
* SUMIFS / COUNTIFS
* IF / Nested IF
* Pivot Tables
* Conditional Formatting
* Data Validation
* Cost comparison
* Rate analysis
* BOQ analysis
* Large project datasets
* Estimation templates
* Costing MIS
* Tender tracking reports

The candidate should be capable of creating structured Excel\-based **estimation, costing and tender comparison sheets**.

**9\. Project Handover \& Post\-Tender Support**

* Coordinate with the Project and Engineering teams after order receipt.
* Explain estimation assumptions, BOQ quantities and costing to the execution team.
* Support post\-award technical and commercial clarifications.
* Assist in identifying variations between tender estimates and actual project requirements.
* Support management in analysing project cost versus estimated cost.

**10\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain proper records of submitted and ongoing tenders.
* Maintain tender status trackers.
* Maintain vendor quotation records.
* Maintain estimation and costing databases.
* Prepare management MIS related to tendering and estimation.
* Maintain historical tender data for future reference.
* Ensure confidentiality of commercial and project costing information.

**Required Qualification**

* BE / B.Tech / Diploma in **Electrical Engineering**.
* 7–12 years of relevant experience in **Estimation / Tendering / Costing**.
* Experience in **Electrical Infrastructure / Power / EPC / Substation / Transmission / Distribution / Solar** projects.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Tender document analysis
* Electrical estimation
* BOQ preparation
* Quantity take\-off
* Rate analysis
* Project costing
* Technical \& commercial bid preparation
* Vendor quotation analysis
* Subcontractor costing
* Material costing
* Advanced MS Excel
* AutoCAD – basic to working knowledge
* Understanding of electrical drawings and SLDs
* Understanding of electrical equipment and materials
* Knowledge of IS / IEC standards
* E\-tendering portals

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Electrical EPC companies
* Power transmission companies
* Power distribution companies
* Substation contractors
* Electrical infrastructure companies
* Solar EPC companies
* MSEDCL / DISCOM projects
* RDSS projects
* MSKVY projects
* 11 kV / 33 kV substation projects
* Transmission projects up to 132 kV / 220 kV / 400 kV
* Government and PSU tenders

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical skills
* Excellent estimation and costing ability
* Strong understanding of electrical infrastructure
* Excellent Excel skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to identify commercial risks
* Good negotiation and vendor coordination skills
* Strong documentation skills
* Good communication skills
* Ability to work under strict tender deadlines
* Ability to handle multiple tenders simultaneously
* Problem\-solving ability
* Strong coordination with Engineering, Procurement, Projects and Finance teams
* Ability to work independently with minimum supervision

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a professional who can independently handle the complete **tender → BOQ → quantity → rate analysis → vendor quotation → costing → technical/commercial bid → final submission** cycle.

Candidates who have worked specifically in **power infrastructure, substations, transmission, distribution or electrical EPC projects** will be preferred over candidates whose experience is limited to general building or construction estimation.

**Location \& Working Requirement**

**Location:** Pune – Office Based

The position is primarily based at the Pune Head Office. Occasional travel to project sites, client meetings, vendor locations or project\-related locations may be required depending on business requirements.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **power infrastructure, substation, transmission, distribution, solar and EPC projects**.
* Exposure to government, utility, PSU and private\-sector tenders.
* Opportunity to work on large\-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Professional growth and exposure to Engineering, Procurement, Projects and Commercial functions.
* Opportunity to work with multidisciplinary project teams.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with:

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period
* Total Experience
* Relevant Estimation/Tendering Experience
* Major Projects Handled
* Experience with Substation / Transmission / Solar / Power Distribution projects

**Email:** hr@electropathservices.com

**Subject:** Application – Senior Estimation \& Tendering Engineer – Pune

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------



We are seeking a skilled Senior Billing Operations Support Engineer to provide hands\-on L2 Application Operations support across telecom billing platforms. This role focuses on ensuring reliable bill\-cycle execution, invoice processing, call/CDR processing, discrepancy management and operational excellence within a production environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining service availability, restoring incidents, improving observability, driving automation and supporting billing accuracy through proactive monitoring, validation and reconciliation activities. This opportunity is based in Pune and is suited to individuals with strong Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing operations experience and a passion for continual service improvement.

**What you will do**
--------------------



Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing  

* Own the day\-to\-day operational health and technical support of billing processes within the assigned service scope.
* Execute and monitor pre\-bill checks, bill preparation, bill production, bill generation, customer notifications and bill\-cycle closure activities.
* Troubleshoot bill\-run failures, rejected accounts, long\-running jobs, database constraints, capacity limitations, scheduler issues and billing exceptions.
* Perform post\-bill validation, billed\-account verification, amount reconciliations and exception management to ensure accurate cycle closure.


Invoice Posting \& Downstream Processing  

* Monitor invoice generation, validation, posting, extraction and downstream delivery processes.
* Investigate invoice rejections, posting failures, missing outputs, balance mismatches and invoice data issues.
* Coordinate operational recovery and issue resolution within agreed service targets.


Call / CDR Processing  

* Monitor call, event and CDR processing, rating and re\-rating activities.
* Manage suspended or rejected records, processing backlogs and delayed usage affecting billing cycles.
* Troubleshoot processing\-chain issues, validation failures, sequencing challenges, capacity concerns and data\-quality exceptions.


Discrepancy Management \& Billing Assurance  

* Analyse discrepancies across customer, product, pricing, discount, billing profile, usage, invoice, payment and accounts receivable data.
* Conduct or coordinate reconciliations across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and downstream platforms.
* Track exceptions through to resolution and identify recurring patterns that may impact billing accuracy or revenue assurance.


Incident, Problem, SLA \& Service Management  

* Lead L2 incident triage and service restoration activities for billing\-related incidents.
* Escalate complex issues to L3 support teams or vendors where required.
* Perform root cause analysis, maintain known\-error records and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance, operational risks, incident ageing and backlog trends.


Automation, AI \& Continual Improvement  

* Automate recurring operational activities including reconciliations, health checks, monitoring, reporting and validations using Shell scripting, SQL and approved automation tools.
* Enhance dashboards, observability solutions and proactive alerting capabilities.
* Leverage approved AI and AIOps capabilities for anomaly detection, event correlation, knowledge retrieval, incident triage and root cause analysis support.
* Contribute to continual improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, billing accuracy and reduced manual effort.


Operational Governance \& Knowledge Management  

* Provide operational updates covering bill\-cycle progress, incidents, service performance and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain runbooks, operational procedures, billing calendars, reconciliation controls, recovery processes and audit evidence.
**Who you are**
---------------



Essential Experience  

* 4\+ years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing Application Operations experience with strong production support responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in bill run processing, invoice posting and processing, call/CDR processing and billing discrepancy management.
* Experience analysing billing failures, processing backlogs, invoice exceptions and reconciliation issues across multiple systems.
* Strong experience in SLA\-driven Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management.
* Proven experience supporting priority incidents and conducting root cause analysis.


Technical Skills  

* Hands\-on experience with telecom billing platforms such as Oracle BRM, Amdocs, Kenan, Geneva/SingleView, BSCS or equivalent solutions.
* Strong Unix/Linux administration and Shell scripting expertise.
* Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills for troubleshooting, reporting, reconciliation and automation.
* Experience with batch processing, schedulers, file management, database performance analysis and log investigation.
* Understanding of interfaces across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing, payment, reporting and document management systems.


Monitoring \& Observability  

* Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Zabbix or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of proactive monitoring, dashboard management, event correlation and alert optimisation.


Additional Knowledge  

* ITIL principles and service management practices.
* Billing assurance, operational controls, auditing and reconciliation processes.
* Understanding of SRE concepts, capacity management and service resilience.
* Exposure to cloud, container platforms or AIOps technologies is desirable.


Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ITIL certification and billing platform certifications are advantageous.
**Not a perfect fit**
---------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Exposure to end\-to\-end billing ecosystems including CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and reporting domains.

title: System Engineer-DCS/VT
description:
**Hello Visionary!**


We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for a System Engineer\-DCS/VT**


As a System Engineer \- Data Communication System (DCS) and Video Transmission System (VTS), you will play a key role in designing and delivering railway telecom networks that support mission\-critical operational systems across complex rail and metro projects. This role offers the opportunity to work on high\-availability communication infrastructure covering trackside, station, depot, and control centre environments, while collaborating with global teams across design, engineering, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover.

**You’ll make a difference by:**

* **Wired Network**
* + Design, configuration, and infrastructure planning of railway data communication networks for station, depot, OCC, and wayside applications.
	+ Hands\-on experience in industrial Ethernet switch and router configuration using platforms such as Cisco, Fortinet, and Ruggedcom/ Scalance for mission\-critical transport applications.
	+ Strong knowledge of communication protocols and services, including TCP/IP, VLANs, RSTP/MSTP, BGP, OSPF, NAT, ARP, DHCP, and DNS.
	+ Proficiency in network diagnostics and troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark, with the ability to analyse latency, packet loss, multicast behaviour, and interface\-level communication issues.
	+ Experience in installation, testing, commissioning, and cutover support of railway or industrial communication networks.
	+ Knowledge of optical fibre backbone, copper access networks, ring architectures, and network redundancy concepts aligned with project requirements and railway standards.
	+ Ability to provide technical support for integrated telecom subsystems and develop migration or switchover plans for commissioned network environments.
* **Wireless Network**
* + Deep understanding of wireless communication principles and IEEE 802\.11 standards relevant to rail and metro communication environments.
* + Strong foundation in RF engineering and antenna theory.
* + Experience in RF design and planning to achieve reliable coverage, seamless roaming, and minimal interference across stations, depots, tunnels, and viaduct sections.
* + Knowledge of antenna placement, propagation modelling, fade margin considerations, and link budget analysis for railway applications.
* + Competence in wireless network architecture for operational, maintenance, and passenger\-information\-related railway applications.
* + Experience in WLAN, WWAN, and WMAN design and deployment.
* + Ability to conduct site surveys, spectrum analysis, and field validation activities in operational railway environments.
* + Hands\-on experience in access point configuration, controller integration, and performance optimisation for rail communication systems.
* + Capability to perform root cause analysis of RF\-related issues.
* + Experience in capacity planning and throughput analysis.
* + Knowledge of spectrum planning, channel reuse, and interference mitigation in dense and operationally constrained rail environments.
* **IT Security**


Design and implementation of cybersecurity measures for railway communication networks, including network device hardening, secure interface design, firewall and DMZ architecture, security logging, and access control. Experience in testing and commissioning of secure network architectures for mission\-critical transport environments is essential.

* **Work assignments:**


Support the Project Lead to rollout of Data Communication Systems (DCS) and Video Transmission Systems (VTS) for large\-scale rail and metro projects, ensuring robust, high\-availability telecom infrastructure for operational and security\-critical applications.


Take end\-to\-end ownership of the telecom application scope from both technical and commercial perspectives, coordinating with OEMs, subsystem suppliers, civil and MEP interfaces, contractors, project management, and customers to ensure successful execution.

* **Application planning, controlling, and reporting:**


Define project objectives for DCS and VTS packages in alignment with customer specifications, interface requirements, telecom architecture, and project management goals. Develop engineering deliverables, implementation plans, and project documentation, and ensure disciplined controlling and reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

* **Application implementation:**


Coordinate the implementation of complex railway telecom applications in collaboration with international partners, ensuring seamless integration with signalling, OCC, station systems, depot systems, and other interfacing subsystems.

* **Exploration of further business opportunities:**


Identify opportunities to create additional value during project execution, including scope enhancements, change requests, and new application work packages that support project and business growth.

* **Leadership:**


Provide technical leadership to the application team, support resource planning, and drive effective collaboration across engineering and project functions to deliver high\-quality, integrated solutions.

* + - Projects Support functions and Quality Management
* + - System Engineering and Hardware and Software Engineering for Interlocking and Diagnostic Systems
* + - Test Management
* + - RAMS Management
* + - Validation.

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Degree in electrical engineering or Electronics and communication engineering preferably
* Extensive professional experience (2\-5 years) in railway transportation systems, ideally in the rail systems business
* At least 2 years of experience in Engineering (Design) in ATP/ATC scope for ETCS L1/L2 domain
* Performed hands on design engineering activities for ETCS L1/L2 trackside
* Extensive knowledge on ETCS L1/L2 operation scenario, national values, terminology and packets/telegram
* Project executions covering activities like customer interfacing, scope clarification, Design / Engineering planning and resource allocation
* Knowledge of project management principles for project realization and execution
* Fluent English essential both written and oral, knowledge of Spanish language will be an asset
* Excellent communication abilities combined with strong interpersonal skill
* High level of customer and quality orientation together with strong abilities in consulting and implementation.

**Join us and be yourself!**


We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.


This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.


We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**Purpose of the role**


To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.


**Accountabilities**


* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.

* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what?s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor?s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*?* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*?* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are looking for an R\&D Engineer with strong 4G and 5G protocol expertise to join the team responsible for real\-time parsing, decoding, and state tracking of mobile core network signalling. You will implement and maintain protocol plugins that process live control\-plane traffic from 4G LTE and 5G NR networks, extracting structured events and session records for downstream analytics.

* **Role: R\&D Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 3 to 5 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain 4G control\-plane protocol parsers and state machines.
* Implement and enhance support for protocols such as S1AP (eNB\-MME Interface), GTP\-C v1/v2, PFCP, SGsAP.
* Design, develop, and maintain 5G control\-plane protocol parsers and state machines.
* Implement and support NGAP communication between NG\-RAN and AMF.
* Develop protocol processing capabilities for 5G Service\-Based Architecture (SBA) network functions including AMF, SMF, UDM, PCF, AUSF, NRF, NEF, CHF, NWDAF, SEPP, UDR, UDSF, BSF, NSSF, LMF, EIR, AF.
* Parse and correlate multi\-message telecom procedures across 4G and 5G protocols.
* Implement cross\-protocol session correlation linking signaling, session management, charging, and network events.
* Maintain protocol decoders in alignment with evolving 3GPP specifications and releases.
* Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests using PCAP\-based traffic replay frameworks.
* Collaborate with packet ingestion teams for messaging interfaces and metadata contracts.
* Contribute to Docker\-based packaging and Helm deployments for Kubernetes environments.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design reviews.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, protocol specifications, and implementation guidelines.
* Analyze protocol traces and troubleshoot complex signaling issues.
* Support performance optimization and scalability improvements for telecom analytics platforms.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in telecom software development or protocol stack development.
* Strong hands\-on experience in C\+\+ systems programming.
* Deep understanding of Object\-Oriented Design and software engineering principles.
* Strong knowledge of 3GPP standards across both 4G EPC and 5G Core networks.
* Experience developing telecom protocol parsers, decoders, or signaling applications.
* Strong understanding of LTE and 5G network architecture.
* Knowledge of EPC components including MME, SGW, PGW, HSS, PCRF.
* Knowledge of 5G Core components including AMF, SMF, UDM, PCF, NRF, AUSF, NSSF.
* Experience working with signaling protocols such as S1AP, NGAP, GTP\-C, PFCP, NAS, and related interfaces.
* Understanding of Service\-Based Architecture (SBA) and REST\-based communication among 5G network functions.
* Experience with protocol analysis, packet decoding, and message correlation.
* Knowledge of telecom call flows, session management, mobility management, and charging workflows.
* Experience working on Linux development environments.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of Docker and containerized deployments.
* Understanding of Kubernetes and cloud\-native application deployment concepts.
* Experience using Git and version control systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
